00001| // The rename tool applies data/meta/rename-map.lino by rule (PR #1188,
00002| // R1188-U5): it derives each rename's companions, finds every reference to an

00004| // tail, renames Rust modules, and re-sorts generated lists.

00023| const WORKER = { from: "js/worker/old_module.js", to: "js/worker/seed_module.js" };

00025| test("the map states each rename once, with its tree, reason and exclusions", () => {
00026|   const map = parseRenameMap([
00027|     "# comment",
00028|     "rename-map",
00029|     '  exclude "dev/log/"',
00030|     '  resort "js/worker-modules.js"',
00031|     "  tree browser-worker-modules",
00032|     "    rename",
00033|     `      from "${WORKER.from}"`,
00034|     `      to "${WORKER.to}"`,
00035|     '      reason "Seed hydration."',
00036|   ].join("\n"));
00037|   assert.deepEqual(map.exclude, ["dev/log/"]);
00038|   assert.deepEqual(map.resort, ["js/worker-modules.js"]);
00039|   assert.deepEqual(map.renames, [{ tree: "browser-worker-modules", ...WORKER, reason: "Seed hydration.", review: "" }]);
00040| });

00042| test("a worker module brings its TypeScript twin and line-budget shard; a Rust source its census", () => {
00043|   const existing = new Set(["ts/worker/old_module.ts", "data/meta/worker-line-budget/old_module.lino"]);
00044|   assert.deepEqual(companionMoves(WORKER, (path) => existing.has(path)).map((move) => [move.to, move.companion]), [
00045|     [WORKER.to, ""],
00046|     ["ts/worker/seed_module.ts", "typescript twin"],
00047|     ["data/meta/worker-line-budget/seed_module.lino", "worker line budget"],
00048|   ]);
00049|   const rust = { from: "rust/src/solver_x.rs", to: "rust/src/solver_routes.rs" };
00050|   assert.deepEqual(companionMoves(rust, (path) => path === "data/meta/self-ast/src/solver_x.lino").map((move) => move.to), [
00051|     "rust/src/solver_routes.rs",
00052|     "data/meta/self-ast/src/solver_routes.lino",
00053|   ]);
00054| });

00056| test("a reference is the whole path, a tail no other file shares, or a relative path that resolves to it", () => {
00057|   const byBasename = indexByBasename([WORKER.from, "rust/tests/unit/a/issue_1.rs", "rust/tests/unit/issue_1.rs"]);
00058|   assert.ok(tokenNames("js/worker/old_module.js", "docs/x.md", WORKER.from, byBasename));

00062|   assert.ok(!tokenNames("src/web/worker/old_module.js", "experiments/x.mjs", WORKER.from, byBasename));
